  1. name: CI/CD Pipeline
  2. ​
  3. on:
  4. push:
  5. branches: [ dev, dev-actions ]
  6. ​
  7. jobs:
  8. build-test-push:
  9. runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  10. ​
  11. steps:
  12. # If your Gitea cert is trusted in the runner image, you can remove this.
  13. - name: Configure Git SSL (temporary if using internal CA)
  14. run: |
  15. git config --global http.sslVerify false
  16. git config --global http."https://gitea.core.home.arpa/".sslVerify false
  17. ​
  18. - name: Verify Docker Environment (TLS Enabled)
  19. run: |
  20. set -x
  21. echo "DOCKER_HOST=${DOCKER_HOST}"
  22. echo "DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY=${DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY}"
  23. echo "DOCKER_CERT_PATH=${DOCKER_CERT_PATH}"
  24. # Check TLS certificates
  25. ls -la /certs/client/ || echo "TLS certs directory not found"
  26. ls -la /certs/client/{ca.pem,cert.pem,key.pem} || echo "TLS cert files not found"
  27. # Check Gitea CA cert
  28. ls -la /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/gitea-ca.crt || echo "Gitea CA cert not found"
  29. docker version
  30. docker info
  31. ​
  32. - name: Checkout Code
  33. uses: actions/checkout@v4
  34. ​
  35. - name: Build image
  36. run: docker build -t reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000/testrepo:latest .
  37. ​
  38. - name: Push image
  39. run: docker push reg.microk8s.core.home.arpa:32000/testrepo:latest
